decisions.reason: Optical spectrum services make use of the firm's owned fibre and match its high-bandwidth, infrastructure-led strategy, although the product no longer appearing on the website adds some uncertainty.
A number ordering portal supports self-service and real-time provisioning at low cost, though it may be folded into a broader customer portal.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service as networks move to all-IP, so freeing its resources for the established business and new development makes sense.
Direct voice network connections remain relevant for enterprise and service-provider customers moving to SIP and cloud voice.
